Yeah, so this is another factor that's been around for decades as well and so commodity benchmarks like the BCOM or the GSCI they roll their futures exposure between the fifth to the nine index business days of every month and so ETFs or index funds or benchmark aware mandates that are following the BCOM or the GSCI they all follow these predefined role calendars that are in the market.

Every single month and the congestion premium comes from trading around these flows so strategies that roll ahead of the congested benchmark role window are referred to as pre role congestion strategies and ones that are rolling after the window or the congested role window are referred to as post role congestion.
